comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the constructs differ in breadth. Left counts any concrete real-world example: a case, event, person, organization, statistic-bearing situation or personal experience. Right counts only a specific, verifiable procedural example, meaning a description of an actual procedure, process, rule, protocol or practice. Right is a materially narrower subtype, so a personal anecdote or named event with no procedure would score 1 on left and 0 on right. The null and empty-list rules also differ: left returns 0 for an empty list, while right folds empty into 0 but states it differently, and the eligibility sets are not the same.
